{{Quote|Two recent human projects&mdash;the miners created for Tarshan Ring Excavations and the infiltration squads requested by the Lords of Purala IV&mdash;began with trials of sterile clones, as requested by both customers.|Hali Ke's internal memorandum|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Tarshan Ring Excavations''', abbreviated as '''TRE''', was a company that, at some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], commissioned the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to produce [[Human/Legends|Human]] clones for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] purposes. The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans']] experimentations with [[Reproduction/Legends|sterile]] clones for the order were ultimately unsuccessful.

==Description==
Tarshan Ring Excavations, also known as TRE, was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that shared its name with the [[Tarshan system/Legends|Tarshan system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|It is certainly irregular to recommend that we deliver an army of clone units able to reproduce. But the TRE and Puralan experiments, as well as my experience with humans, tell me that we have no choice if we also want an army that can fight effectively.|Hali Ke's internal memorandum|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
[[File:Kamino_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tarshan Ring Excavations placed an order with the cloners of the planet Kamino.]]
At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Tarshan Ring Excavations commissioned the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to create [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. Similarly as with another of the cloners' customers, the [[Lords of Purala IV]], Tarshan Ring Excavations requested that the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] begin the project with trials of clones that were [[Reproduction/Legends|sterile]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

In both cases, the clone prototypes suffered from impairments in [[Brain/Legends|mental]] stability, unit cohesion, adaptation and creative thought abilities, and aggressiveness in combat simulations. The various corrective measures subsequently employed by the cloners were unable to significantly improve the effectiveness of the clones, and in an internal memorandum composed not long thereafter, in 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Hali Ke]] noted the results of the TRE experiment as one of the reasons why the clones commissioned for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were instead [[Bioengineering/Legends|engineered]] to be able to reproduce.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tarshan Ring Excavations was originally meant to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned it was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the company was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
